alt_text: The seating has dark gray vertically ribbed upholstery, illuminated vertical strips along both front arm edges, circular cup holders built into the armrests, and a control panel mounted on the outside of the left arm. The right seat is reclined with its footrest extended. Open compartments beneath and in front of the seating contain a blanket, a cushion, and books; one front compartment has its hinged lid raised.
